  answer:
    Coaching patterns across calls (category = fee_dispute)

    - Missed Opportunity to Empathize: 14 of 19 calls in "Uninformed Overdraft Fee Increase". Agent did not actively acknowledge or empathize with members' frustration about not being notified of the fee change via a more noticeable method.
        CALL-00583: "I never saw an insert. I'd have kept more in checking if I'd known."
        CALL-00624: "I don't read the inserts. Nobody called or emailed me about this."
        CALL-00529: "I don't read the inserts. Nobody called or emailed me about this."

    - Did Not Explain Fee Structure Clearly: 10 of 13 calls in "Multiple Overdraft Fees in a Day". The agent did not clearly explain that overdraft fees are charged per item, leading to members being surprised by the total fee amount for a single day.
        CALL-00400: "They were charged per item on the same day, at $35.00 each since April 15."
        CALL-00593: "Several items cleared on the same day, so each one was charged."
        CALL-00389: "They were charged per item on the same day, at $35.00 each since April 15."

    - Stated Courtesy Waiver Policy: 9 of 12 calls in "Courtesy Refund Limit". Agent frequently mentioned the courtesy waiver policy, allowing one waiver per rolling 12 months.
        CALL-00348: "The courtesy waiver is a one-time courtesy for the life of the account, and yours has already been used, so I can't refund this one."
        CALL-00601: "I checked, and the courtesy waiver can be used once every 12 months."
        CALL-00306: "Under the courtesy waiver policy, we can waive one overdraft fee per rolling 12 months."

    - Inconsistent Handling of Feedback: 5 of 19 calls in "Uninformed Overdraft Fee Increase". Agent did not consistently follow up on members' feedback about preferring alternative notification methods for fee changes.
        CALL-00376: "I wish I'd gotten a message."
        CALL-00481: "I wish I'd gotten a message."
        CALL-00465: "I wish I'd gotten a message."

    - Offer Additional Support: 4 of 7 calls in "Lack of Notification". Agent offered to email the updated fee schedule to members who expressed they missed the initial notification.
        CALL-00615: "Understood. I'll note your feedback, and I can email you the new schedule so you have it."
        CALL-00531: "Understood. I'll note your feedback, and I can email you the new schedule so you have it."
        CALL-00342: "Understood. I'll note your feedback, and I can email you the new schedule so you have it."

    - Refund Offer: 4 of 7 calls in "Unexpected Monthly Fees". Agent offered a refund as a courtesy in most calls, mentioning the fee waiver conditions.
        CALL-00382: "I can refund this month's fee as a courtesy."
        CALL-00387: "I can refund this month's fee as a courtesy."
        CALL-00547: "As a courtesy, I can refund this month's fee."

    - Inflexible on Fee Waiver Policy: 3 of 13 calls in "Multiple Overdraft Fees in a Day". The agent consistently refused to refund overdraft fees even when members asked politely, citing the one-time courtesy waiver policy and that it had already been used.
        CALL-00396: "The waiver is a one-time courtesy, once ever, and I see it was applied to your account before."
        CALL-00423: "Not under the waiver rule. I'm sorry I couldn't give you a better answer."
        CALL-00623: "I can't refund this fee."

    - Repeatedly Mentioned Overdraft Fee Structure: 2 of 12 calls in "Courtesy Refund Limit". Agent consistently explained the $35.00 per item overdraft fee structure across multiple calls.
        CALL-00602: "The fee is $35.00 per item since April 15."
